scope: Real TextEdit tasks through the MCP-first executor, Apple on-device planner, signed helper, and HostComputerUseManager with a local test channel.
previousGoalTurn: Verified progress: ec65597 added real native MCP document tasks.
problem: Take Control before the first approval cancelled the helper and invalidated the pending action correctly, but Resume rejected the retained document task even though no action had been claimed.
repair: Retain the exact semantic edit and trusted prompt before the first claim. Rebind only when no plan has entered approval dispatch and no action has been confirmed.
Recheck the same live AX control, application, window, document identity and complete original text/file; prepare fresh helper-bound approval without rerunning the planner.
Already attempted or confirmed work keeps the existing ordered ledger continuation. Changed documents do not receive replacement edits or Save.
Fresh approval uses the replacement helper generation. Late old approval responses are ignored both while paused and after Resume.
sourceBinding: Production source did not change after the first green handoff trial. Later test-only extensions added changed-document, late-response and selection scenarios. The artifact records each driver stage and final source hashes.
limitations: The real app and helper use a test channel with task-scoped Pause/Resume commands. This is not a physical phone, full HostSession or rendered host-control UI test.
No edits during handoff completes with two verified effects and fresh approval; user text changes deliberately stop continuation to preserve them. Selection-only changes succeed.
Process restart, changed application/window identity, global keyboard dispatch races, long-document reflow, other apps and rich/unsaved documents remain unqualified.
The existing UI-responsiveness warning remains in real native runs. Normal managed helper setup, provider login, phone, whole-app 12 GB RAM and heat acceptance remain open.
The installed host remains running; no trained computer-use model, purchase, send, push or release is involved.
